title: Replace hand-rolled ==/hashCode on PaceCalculator, LifetimeLeafProvenance and RecentActivityWindow with @freezed or a record
rule: naming/placement — domain/state models are @freezed; never hand-write ==/hashCode for data classes
why: Three separate hand-written equality implementations exist in this one feature slice alongside a fourth model file (journey_view_model.dart) that correctly uses @freezed for the same kind of value object, and alongside sibling family-key records elsewhere in this same batch (e.g. lifetime_knowledge_providers.dart's ({int profileId, CurriculumId curriculumId})) that get structural equality for free. Hand-rolled equality is exactly the boilerplate freezed exists to generate and keep in sync; PaceCalculator's == only compares 6 of its 13 fields (the derived ones are excluded) which is easy to get wrong silently the next time a field is added, since nothing forces == and hashCode to be touched together.
recommendation: Convert PaceCalculator and LifetimeLeafProvenance to @freezed classes (both fit the private-const-factory-plus-named-computing-factory pattern already used elsewhere for derived-field value objects); convert RecentActivityWindow to a named-field record (({DateTime startDate, DateTime endDate, String? curriculumId})) to match the record-based family keys already used in this same feature.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn 'bool operator ==' lib/features/progress/ (excluding .freezed.dart/.g.dart) returns no hits.
